text: Good evening, detective. I'm Inspector Hart, and I'm glad you're here.
We have a case that needs a sharp pair of eyes.
Last night, the gold Design of the Year award vanished from the display case at Kite Design Studio, just hours before the company's big exhibition.
The case was found open this morning.
Four people had a reason to be near the studio last night. One of them took the award.
Last night, Datuk Hashim Karim, founder of the Heritage Gallery, was found dead in the Melaka Room.
Someone was secretly swapping real pieces for replicas, and the Datuk was about to expose them.
Four people had access. Find who was here when he died, and prove it.
Search the room. When you find something important, pick it up or touch it, then tap Tag as evidence.
At the evidence board, choose the suspect who did it, pin the evidence that proves it, and submit. You can only submit once.
You're working alone on this one.
You're working with a partner. Talk to each other and decide together. Either of you can submit.
One more thing: don't step into the marked areas on the floor. They're part of the crime scene. And please don't run after anything you drop.
When you're ready, press Start. Good luck, detective.
